artifact_kind: derived semantic crosswalk, NOT an original JSON Schema or proven runtime
privacy: No product, campaign, supplier or customer values copied. Key spellings below preserved where present; explanatory field lists paraphrased.

current_commissioning_overlay.status: Current owner-approved requirements, NOT recovered historical fields, source quotations, an executable schema or evidence of a completed implementation. The historical contracts array below is preserved unchanged.
current_commissioning_overlay.delivery: Completed full owner-controlled multi-brand private-cloud autonomous ecommerce engine; not a smaller core or future out-of-contract vision.

required_for_each_test: live budgeted campaign with actual platform IDs
recorded decision tied to exact product, creative, offer, page and campaign versions
acceptance.measurement: Preagree measurement windows, stop rules and decision criteria; retain failures and insufficient evidence honestly. No guaranteed profitable winners.
acceptance.spend_authority: Separate operating-spend approval is required. The build fee and test target do not authorize spend.
acceptance.initial_work_samples: Distinct from final acceptance; a demo, scaffold, disconnected automation or partial build is unacceptable final delivery.

included_capabilities.shopify_stores: Domains, branding, native Liquid, responsive navigation, policies, configured payment/shipping and functional checkout.
included_capabilities.catalog: Bulk creation and management of products, variants, collections, media, copy, prices, metafields and templates; import/migration, stable platform IDs and duplicate-safe retries.
included_capabilities.conversion_and_discovery: Bundles, upsells, cross-sells, post-purchase flows and measured SEO/AEO/GEO tests.
included_capabilities.meta: Facebook Pages/configuration, Instagram links as applicable, business/ad accounts, catalogs, Pixel/CAPI, consent, browser/server deduplication and purchase verification against actual test orders.
included_capabilities.connected_operations: Sourcing, quotes, supplier diligence, negotiation, sample/QC, purchasing, order routing, 3PL fulfillment, shipment tracking, returns, support, retention, accounting and profitability.
included_capabilities.boundary: Connected operation and integration, not ownership of a warehouse or payment rail. Owner/KYC/legal approvals and account access are dependencies to resolve, not scope exclusions.

reference_to_execution.meaning: CREATE required capabilities inside the owned engine, not a SaaS link bundle, mandatory vendor subscriptions or a clone of every proprietary feature/dataset.
reference_to_execution.workflow: Permitted scraping/capture of ads/pages; analyze hooks, pacing, narrative, CTA and angles; create ORIGINAL product-specific finished ads/pages; launch, measure and improve.
reference_to_execution.review: Actually decode/render and visually/functionally inspect finished outputs and purchase paths against references, then produce the next measured iteration. Retain sources, rights, versions, attempts and review decisions.

runtime_and_cost.usage: BOTH engines power development AND the deployed engine through verified official supported access, capacity and runtime terms. Do not assume subscriptions include API credits or unattended private-cloud rights.
runtime_and_cost.aggregator_condition: Only when its complete workflow/skill improves the rendered result, behind an owned replaceable adapter.
runtime_and_cost.approval: No unapproved spend. Verify entitlements, commercial rights, limits and costs for all subscriptions, APIs, media, campaigns and operations.

futureproofing.goal: Keep up with the AI race, newer models, better agents and increasingly AGI-like capabilities through tested adaptability, not literal AGI immunity or a lifetime-maintenance promise.
futureproofing.stage_changes: Combine/remove obsolete stages while preserving required outcomes and evidence.
futureproofing.preserve: Owner-controlled data, business context, history, source assets and stable platform IDs, with versions, exports and demonstrated restore. Configuration restore does not undo published actions or spend.

commercial_terms.before_hire: Agree final price, schedule, milestones, access dependencies and measurement windows.
commercial_terms.milestones: Stage COMPLETE delivery, not reduced scope.
commercial_terms.estimation: Expect efficient Codex/Claude-assisted engineering and vibe coding; unsupported padded manual estimates are unacceptable. Honest technical pushback is welcome; integration, creative finishing and verification still require real work.

contracts.name: Research Document
contracts.input_meaning: Product brief, scorecard, margin analysis, competition assessment and competitor URLs seed evidence collection.
structure: VOC phrase/exact quote, frequency count, source, theme
Competitor positioning, offer, pricing, guarantee, creative angle, gap
Objections and failed solutions with supporting source language
Mechanism and surprising-information opportunities with sources
contracts.consumer: Avatar/angle builders, then script and page writers
contracts.effect: Ground message choice in observed customer language; preserve provenance rather than treating generated personas as facts

contracts.name: brief.json
contracts.limitations: Four named sections are prose, not a fully enumerated JSON key/type schema

contracts.name: prompts.json
contracts.effect: Carry brief intent and brand attributes into generation; split clips/fields without losing branch symmetry

contracts.name: Multi-clip generation and editing
structure: each clip receives full branch outputs
contracts.effect: Plans become clips; clips plus overlays/audio/editing become candidate finished ads
contracts.limitations: This source outputs a plan plus historical STOP blocks, not proof of rendered finished ads

contracts.name: Campaign specification and results
contracts.input_meaning: Accepted creatives, page destinations, targeting and budget create campaign/adset/ad structure.
structure: UTM naming and live campaign IDs
Spend, ROAS/CPA, hook rate, hold rate, average play time, CVR, AOV, share of campaign spend
Next batch: control ad, test variant, success metric, kill threshold
contracts.consumer: daily optimizer -> feedback analyst -> next creative/research batch
contracts.limitations: Campaign format and absolute thresholds are historical hypotheses, not current API facts or current owner constraints

contracts.name: Dossier and status contract
golden_variables: TOP phrases with count and corpus percentage
contracts.consumer: successive research, creative, page, store, launch and iteration stages
contracts.limitations: Markdown schema only. Actual dossier.py parser/status JSON not read. Both S8_iterate and later S11_iterate appear, signaling version layering to reconcile.

contracts.name: COGS_verified
contracts.input_meaning: Supplier variant, warehouse, shipping and tariff evidence establish landed cost rather than guessed economics.
contracts.limitations: Actual tested-product query terms omitted. Country-wide tariff assertions and hardcoded supplier defaults require current verification; do not import as universal formula.
